name: The six that destroy yoga (HYP 1.15)
description: The text says yoga is destroyed by six: overeating (atyāhāra), exertion (prayāsa), idle talk (prajalpa), clinging to rules (niyamagraha), the company of people (janasaṅga) and fickleness or greed (laulya).
